concept.hr: Jedna administratorska prijava na radnoj stanici otvara cijelu domenu
concept.en: One admin logon on a workstation exposes the whole domain

summary.hr: Korak po korak: napadač s WS1 kopira vjerodajnice iz memorije i prelazi dalje. LAPS siječe lokalni sažetak, slojevi ga zaustavljaju u sloju 2.
summary.en: Step by step: from WS1 the attacker copies credentials from memory and moves on. LAPS cuts the local hash; tiering stops the attacker at Tier 2.

concept.hr: LAPS siječe lokalni sažetak, ali ne štiti domenskog administratora
concept.en: LAPS cuts the local hash but does not protect the Domain Admin

concept.hr: Administrator sloja 0 ne prijavljuje se na radne stanice: nema što ukrasti
concept.en: A Tier 0 admin never logs on to a workstation: nothing to steal

concept.hr: Od radne stanice preko poslužitelja do kontrolera domene
concept.en: From a workstation through a server to the domain controller
